title: Jar - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Jar in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Jar is an early optional boss with an unusually wide weakness list: four elements land, while Physical is the resisted one. Its Chromatic form keeps the same profile.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toFire, Ice, Earth, Lightning
ResistsPhysical
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneNone

Bring Fire, Ice, Earth, Lightning damage. Physical is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Colour of Lumina
  • Chroma Catalyst
  • Pictos or weapon tied to the encounter

Exact drop quantities for this encounter are not documented in the sources we could verify, so they are not listed rather than estimated.

sections.title: How to Beat the Jar
sections.content:
What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
